name: dezoomify-extension
description: Detect zoomable images in web pages and download them with dezoomify

scripts.test:chrome: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'));const failures=[];if(manifest.manifest_version!==3){failures.push('manifest_version must be 3');}if(!manifest.action||!manifest.action.default_title){failures.push('action.default_title is required');}if(!manifest.action||!manifest.action.default_icon){failures.push('action.default_icon is required');}if(!manifest.background||!manifest.background.service_worker){failures.push('background.service_worker is required');}if(!Array.isArray(manifest.permissions)||!manifest.permissions.includes('webRequest')){failures.push('permissions must include webRequest');}if(!Array.isArray(manifest.permissions)||!manifest.permissions.includes('contextMenus')){failures.push('permissions must include contextMenus');}if(!Array.isArray(manifest.host_permissions)||!manifest.host_permissions.includes('<all_urls>')){failures.push('host_permissions must include <all_urls>');}if(failures.length){console.error('Chrome manifest checks failed:');failures.forEach((failure)=>console.error('- '+failure));process.exit(1);}console.log('Chrome manifest checks passed.');"
scripts.test:ci: npm run build && npm run test:types && npm run test:firefox && npm run test:chrome && npm run test:load
